categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily operates in real estate development, real estate brokerage and agency, construction contracting, commercial building leasing and sales, building materials trading, and interior decoration. It also engages in advertising services, software wholesale, data processing, and third-party payment services through subsidiaries. The main revenue drivers are real estate agency and sales commissions, construction project income, and property development sales.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company employs innovative architectural planning and design by hiring renowned architects and design teams, focusing on sustainable, safe, and healthy residential buildings. Construction management emphasizes strict quality control, safety, progress monitoring, and cost control. The company integrates urban renewal and joint development projects, leveraging advanced engineering techniques and project management methods to enhance competitiveness.
categories.primary_customers_markets: The primary customers are homebuyers, first-time buyers, and commercial real estate clients in Taiwan, especially in northern Taiwan regions such as New Taipei City, Taipei City, Hsinchu, Taoyuan, and other redevelopment zones. The company also serves corporate clients expanding office and warehouse needs, particularly those related to emerging AI and technology industries. The market is domestic with a focus on residential and commercial real estate sectors.
categories.geographic_coverage: Operations are concentrated entirely within Taiwan, with a focus on northern Taiwan including Taipei, New Taipei City, Hsinchu, Taoyuan, and other key urban redevelopment and new town areas. The company does not have overseas securities listings or significant international operations.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the real estate supply chain, including land development, construction contracting (through subsidiaries), real estate brokerage, and sales agency services. It controls construction projects and manages sales and marketing but relies on subcontractors and suppliers for materials and labor.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include deepening expertise in real estate agency and development, focusing on urban renewal and joint development projects aligned with government policies. The company emphasizes innovative architectural design, sustainable and smart building concepts, and cost-effective construction management. Market research and economic trend analysis guide product positioning and marketing strategies. Talent development and strengthening construction capabilities are also key R&D directions.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through commissions from real estate agency and sales services, income from construction contracting projects, and sales of developed properties. Additional income streams include leasing commercial buildings and trading building materials. The company also earns from advertising and software services via subsidiaries.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company competes with other large real estate developers and agencies in northern Taiwan, holding a leading position in real estate agency market share and project volume. It benefits from strong brand recognition, extensive project portfolio, and integrated services across development, construction, and sales. Competitors include other established real estate developers and large-scale agency firms with diversified portfolios.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: The company reported consolidated revenue of approximately NT$11.16 billion in 2024, a 37.7% increase from the previous year, marking a historical high. Net profit reached about NT$1.9 billion with earnings per share of NT$3.07. The company has shown steady growth in assets, equity, and profitability, supported by increased construction and sales activities. Capital structure is robust with ongoing capital increases and debt management.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company differentiates itself by offering competitively priced, consumer-oriented real estate products with distinctive features, emphasizing quality, safety, and environmental sustainability. It leverages innovative architectural design tailored to local characteristics and integrates urban renewal projects to create added value. Comprehensive after-sales service and strong brand reputation foster customer trust and loyalty.
